mapper.select: -- 查询当前用户发布的图片详情 SELECT i.id as mid, i.imgs_url, i.content, i.agree_count, i.comment_count, i.update_time as time, a.id as album_id, a.name as album_name, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS username, u.avatar AS avatar, if(ac.uid != '' ,1,0)as is_agree FROM t_img_detail AS i LEFT JOIN blade_user AS u ON i.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_album_img_relation as air on i.id = air.mid left join t_album as a on a.id = air.aid left join t_agree_collect as ac on ac.agree_collect_id = i.id and ac.type =1 and ac.uid = #{uid} WHERE (i.user_id in (SELECT fid from t_follow where uid = #{uid} ) or i.user_id = #{uid} ) and a.uid = i.user_id and i.status = 1 ORDER BY i.update_time DESC LIMIT ${offset},${limit}
